main_text.p: פִּתְכְּרָא, פַּתְכָּרָא Ch. Idolum, imago. Plur. פִּתְכָּרֵי Idola. Syr. ܦܬܟܐ Idem.
פַּתְכּוּמָרִין Ch. Idola. Vide Mercerum Sophon.1.5.
פְּתַל Ch. Intorquere, contorquere. Ithpah. Partic. וּמִפְתַּלִין Et perversæ sunt, Prov.2.15.
פְּתַלָּן Ch. Perversus. Fœm. פְּתַלָּנָא, Deut.32.5.in T.H.
פְּתַם, פִּתְמָנָאִי, Vide in seq. rad.
פְּתַן, פְּתָנָא, פִּתַן Ch. Aspis, Serpens regulus. Plural. פִּתָנֵי, פִּתְנִין Deuter.32.33.in Onk. Jonathan habet פִּתּוּנְיָא. Targum Hierosol. פִּתְמָנָאִי, quod pravum.
פְּתוּנְיָא Ch. Nomen proprium viri, ut videtur, Esth. 6.9. in T. sec.
פְּתַק Ch. Jacere, ejicere, projicere sagittas, Gen.49. 8. in Jonath. & 14.19. Item Cessare, definere, idem sc. quod פָּסַק Genes.8.22. in T. Hierosol.
פִּתְקָא, פְּתַק Ch. Idem quod פִּטְקָא, Liber, libellus, epistola, diploma: Item nomen vasis sive poculi apud Persas, Est.1.8. in Targ. sec.
פָּתַךְ Ch. Interpretatus est, Genes. 40.12. & 18. in Targ. Hierosol.
פִּתּוֹרָא, פְּתוֹר Ch. & Syr. Mensa: Mesa numularia in qua pecuniæ cōmutantur, Gen.23.15.in T. Jon. & Hierosol.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac headwords and entries are rendered as far as legible; vowel points and some Syriac forms are approximate. No marginal notes printed. Page number 463 is printed at top left.
